reconstruction_scope: registered native reader; independent of recorded completion
mutations: same origin and per-session token; fixed argv without shell
archives: fresh job child directory; UI administration outside native inventory

archive_library.roots: explicit startup read-only roots; opaque IDs and relative paths
archive_library.administration: own GUI workspace outside source archives

m5.scope: original synthetic native reports only; no candidate import, fitting or execution
m5.copy_boundary: fixed in-place verification then original report bytes bound to frozen source inventory in fresh GUI output
m5.declaration: worker-verified model declaration; model/source/state binding and supplier self-attestation, withdrawn with report snapshot
m5.metrics: native U/day; full eligible baseline separate from paired baseline/candidate; null metrics on zero paired support

campaigns.reports: owned worker snapshots; JSON and Markdown without pooled outcomes

durable_archives.store: explicit existing canonical startup root outside current checkout; new opaque children only; registration by allowed root ID and relative directory
durable_archives.reader_trust: explicit clean checkout at recorded full Git revision; full tracked bytes equal Git objects and preserved reader inventory; package snapshots never executed
durable_archives.reports: integrity, reconstruction and numerical completeness shown separately; no automatic resume

m3.preparation: explicit synthetic byte access; original configuration retained, only selected roster and paths adapted
m3.check: native metadata/runtime readiness; no predictor execution or observation-content validation
m3.reports: native JSON and Markdown; execution, reconstruction and complete cohort separate
m3.forensic: fresh opaque external-store child, exact raw evidence, no verified package or reader claim

observations.scope: Synthetic local CSV and frozen fixed-kinetic plans only; no causal callback or human data route
observations.input_root: Current checkout; explicit files, no symlinks/hidden paths

sampling.scope: Full versus two or three reduced actual-time schedules, independent shared-core refits and all failures; no empirical equivalence or clinical schedule recommendation
